description: This file contains unit tests for the SessionData components in the OpenClaw project, testing functions related to session kind detection, token formatting, usage percentage clamping, and session row flag labels.

methods.name: session kind from key detects common kinds
methods.description: Tests detection of session kinds based on different keys.

methods.name: session token stats format K tokens rounds as expected
methods.description: Tests formatting of token counts into human-readable strings.

methods.name: session token stats percent used clamps to100
methods.description: Checks that the percent used calculation caps at 100%.

methods.name: session row flag labels include non default flags
methods.description: Ensures that session row flags include labels for non-default flags.
